name: UPAS TIEUT
key_symptoms: Lancinating pain throughout right lung toward the liver, stopping breathing. Violent palpitation; sensation of heaviness in stomach.
Disinclined for mental work. Irritable. Dull headache deep in brain.

urinary_symptoms: Desire increased, with loss of power. Dull backache, as after excessive coitus.
skin_symptoms: Numb hands and feet. Hangnails inflamed; itching and redness of roots of nails.
